Name: TP's Linus Portrait_for Sabbit's White Mage
Author: Tampey
Description:
This is [url=http://blog.naver.com/sebbit133/223185439282]Custom NPC White Mage Linus[/url] Portrait.
i made it drawing. Thank you Sabbit for making White Mage Linus :)

Only Linus by name, different from the Vanilla character Linus by Stardew Valley.


There are two versions of this file.
>> short hair ver / Long hair ver
You can choose between the two.


[b]Need to rename the image you want to use before you put it in the file.

[u]These download files don't have a manifast.json file. You have to find and add the path file yourself.[/u][/b]


[b]How to install[/b]

[list]
[*]If you don't already have them, download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ mod 
[*]Download this mod.
[*]Mods/Portraiture/Portraits and create a new folder.
[*]Put the portraits from this mod into the new folder.
[/list]
Can use both Portraiture and PortraiturePlus . I usually use Portraiture, and I can't explain this because I don't use Portraitureplus (Because I don't know how to it)

If you have any problems with this file, please let me know. Feedback is welcome :)
